Likhu school cannot be reached, because all three roads into it are damaged. Its 1 child and 4 injured people must be deferred, which costs 60 + 4×80 = 380.

Rescuing any of the adults costs more in driving than it saves in penalties:
- **Trishuli market:** the route from the shelter is 12 + 31 + 17 = 60 minutes each way. A round trip is 120 minutes to save 4 adults, which would otherwise cost 4×20 = 80.
- **Thakre market:** the route is 79 minutes each way, so a round trip is 158 minutes. Picking up all 4 adults on one trip (3 at Thakre, 1 at Trishuli) also costs 158 minutes, against 80 saved.

So the cheapest plan is to defer everyone, and the car stays put. The 7 adults cost 7×20 = 140 in penalties.

<plan>
defer likhu-school child 1
defer likhu-school injured 4
defer thakre-market adult 3
defer trishuli-market adult 4
</plan>

COST: 520
